description: This file implements push notification handling for Mattermost, including notification types, push notification hub management, message building, and communication with push proxy services.

classes.name: PushNotificationsHub
classes.description: Manages push notification dispatching, including a channel for notifications, worker goroutines, and synchronization primitives.

classes.name: PushNotification
classes.description: Represents a push notification with details such as type, user, channel, post, and mention flags.

methods.name: sendPushNotificationSync
methods.description: Builds and sends a push notification synchronously for a specific post and user.

methods.name: sendPushNotificationToAllSessions
methods.description: Sends a push notification to all active sessions of a user, handling plugin hooks and session filtering.

methods.name: sendPushNotification
methods.description: Queues a push notification to the hub for dispatch.

methods.name: getPushNotificationMessage
methods.description: Generates the message content for a push notification based on various parameters.

methods.name: getUserBadgeCount
methods.description: Retrieves the unread badge count for a user, including thread mentions if CRT is enabled.

methods.name: clearPushNotificationSync
methods.description: Clears push notifications for a user session, updating badge count.

methods.name: clearPushNotification
methods.description: Queues a clear notification for a user session.

methods.name: updateMobileAppBadgeSync
methods.description: Updates the badge count on the mobile app for a user.

methods.name: UpdateMobileAppBadge
methods.description: Queues an update badge request for a user.

methods.name: createPushNotificationsHub
methods.description: Initializes the push notifications hub with channels, goroutines, and configuration.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Runs the main loop of the push notifications hub, processing queued notifications.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops the push notifications hub, draining channels and waiting for goroutines.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops the push notification worker goroutines.

methods.name: rawSendToPushProxy
methods.description: Sends a push notification message to the push proxy server via HTTP.

methods.name: sendToPushProxy
methods.description: Handles sending a push notification to the push proxy and processes the response.

methods.name: SendAckToPushProxy
methods.description: Sends an acknowledgment for received push notifications to the proxy.
